## Task 1 · The potion shop (2 marks)

A shop sells potions. The matrix P gives the prices in coins: row 1 = small
potions, row 2 = big potions; column 1 = health, column 2 = mana,
column 3 = speed.

P has the rows (4, 6, 5) and (9, 12, 10).

a) What is the size of P, and what is p~23~? What does p~23~ mean in the
shop? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) On a sale day, every price is multiplied by 0.5, and then a delivery fee
matrix F with the rows (1, 1, 1) and (2, 2, 2) is added. Compute 0.5P + F.
(1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}

## Task 2 · The portal spell (3 marks)

A portal spell is the matrix S with the rows (3, 0) and (0, 3). A key stands
at K = (2, −1).

a) Compute S × K. Where does the key land? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) Write the inverse S^−1^: the matrix that undoes S. Say in words what it
does. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

c) Check that S^−1^ brings the key back to (2, −1). (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}
